description: This file defines the 'Leave' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the 'ohrm_leave' database table. It includes properties for leave details such as date, duration, status, related leave request, leave type, employee, start and end times, and duration type. The class uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes methods to get and set properties, along with relevant constants for leave statuses and duration types.

classes.name: Leave
classes.description: Entity class representing a leave record, including properties for leave details, ORM mappings, constants for statuses and duration types, and methods for property access and modification.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the leave record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the leave record.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the leave.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date of the leave.

methods.name: getLengthHours
methods.description: Returns the length of leave in hours.

methods.name: setLengthHours
methods.description: Sets the length of leave in hours, formatted to 2 decimal places.

methods.name: getLengthDays
methods.description: Returns the length of leave in days.

methods.name: setLengthDays
methods.description: Sets the length of leave in days, formatted to 4 decimal places.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the leave.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the leave.

methods.name: getLeaveRequest
methods.description: Returns the associated leave request.

methods.name: setLeaveRequest
methods.description: Associates a leave request with this leave.

methods.name: getLeaveType
methods.description: Returns the type of leave.

methods.name: setLeaveType

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the employee associated with the leave.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an employee with this leave.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time of the leave.

methods.name: setStartTime
methods.description: Sets the start time of the leave.

methods.name: getEndTime
methods.description: Returns the end time of the leave.

methods.name: setEndTime
methods.description: Sets the end time of the leave.

methods.name: getDurationType
methods.description: Returns the duration type of the leave.

methods.name: setDurationType
methods.description: Sets the duration type of the leave.
